base_rho_semantics: channel covariance rho*g*g.T+(1-rho)*diag(p**2) of the reference-cell structure; 0 = channel-private A4 base, temporal PSD unchanged
theta_sd_semantics: SDs of E2 uniform ranges (3,0.1,0.04)/sqrt(12); E1b linear fixture s=J0*dtheta
cell_grid: two one-factor sweeps, not a Cartesian product; (0,0) is the clean reference
line_frequency: argmax non-DC reference-template rFFT power; lower bin on exact tie
line_channel_loading: all ones with zero relative phase
common_basis: top two exact real-circulant eigendirections; each mean square one
displacement: population maximum principal angle in degrees between the top-3 context CCA functionals (linearised fixture) and R_c = top-3 GEVP of (A_c Sigma_theta A_c^T, N_cc); gamma_n reported separately
covariance: H_A4 kron T + epsilon_dc I + 11.T kron (line_multiplier*v_white*(cc.T+ss.T)+common_strength*v_white/2*V.T*V)
